items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Well then 27 he was with Louis DuBois.

ctx.x: In 47 he went to California. In 47. Yeah. About 27. Did I say 27? No, I said he went away in 1927. No, not 27 because he taught me music in the 30s.
Well then 27 he was with Louis DuBois. Yeah. Well, what was it? I can remember that.
He went to California during the war, right? In the fall.
